layers.name: Pants (sprites)
layers.description: Two hires sprites animate parts of the pirate’s pants across six frames.

layers.name: Sprites
layers.description: 17 carefully timed multiplexed sprites behind the bitmap layer.

layers.name: G+P logo
layers.description: Subtle but visible, the G+P logo uses four sprites to create an interlaced color-flicker animation.

layers.name: Hand and doll (sprites)
layers.description: Two multicolor sprites behind the hand create the doll’s two-frame animation.

layers.name: Hires character data
layers.description: The artwork uses hires character mode with up to 256 unique characters. The beard and clothes animate across six frames by rewriting selected character tiles.

layers.name: Hand and doll (hires character data)
layers.description: The doll’s animation changes the character data across two frames.

layers.name: Sprite above character data
layers.description: A single sprite sits above the bitmap artwork to form the pirate’s hat.
